## SnapSort 1.3.2 — Crash fixed

**Fixed: SnapSort closing as soon as it opened.** Versions 1.3.0 and 1.3.1 crashed at launch on every phone. The background filing added in 1.3.0 was being stripped out of the release build by mistake; it's now kept, and the app opens normally again. Sorry about that.

- If SnapSort ever does crash again, it remembers why and offers to share a short report the next time you open it. Nothing is sent unless you choose to.
- X screenshots on Samsung phones are now filed under X instead of Other.

**Also in 1.3**
- **Knows the app even when the file name doesn't.** Turn on Usage access once and SnapSort looks up the app that was open at the exact moment you took each screenshot. Without it, SnapSort recognises the app from how the screenshot looks — fixed rules, no AI — and leaves it in Other when it isn't sure.
- **Swipe to clean.** Left to delete, right to keep, up to favorite, with undo. Everything you mark is deleted together at the end, after a summary.
- Installs on every Android phone, including 32-bit ones like the Samsung Galaxy A10.

Updating? Just install over the old version — your albums and favorites stay.
